claims.hr: DAO (diaminooksidaza) je glavni enzim koji razgrađuje histamin unesen hranom u crijevima.
claims.en: DAO (diamine oxidase) is the main enzyme that breaks down dietary histamine in the gut.

claims.hr: Alkohol smanjuje razgradnju/aktivnost DAO i potiče oslobađanje tjelesnog histamina.
claims.en: Alcohol reduces DAO breakdown/activity and triggers release of the body’s histamine.

claims.hr: Citrus i jagode djeluju kao liberatori — potiču oslobađanje tjelesnog histamina.
claims.en: Citrus and strawberries act as liberators — they trigger release of the body’s histamine.

claims.hr: Fermentirana, zrela i odstajala hrana tipično sadrži visok histamin.
claims.en: Fermented, aged and non-fresh foods typically contain high histamine.

claims.hr: Simptomi se često jave ~30 min nakon jela i preklapaju se s drugim stanjima (npr. IBS).
claims.en: Symptoms often appear ~30 min after eating and overlap with other conditions (e.g. IBS).
